dedupe_keys.name: a detailed comparison of energy management results for multiple railway smart grid schemes

description: A Detailed Comparison of Energy Management Results for Multiple Railway Smart Grid Schemes is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Yichen Feng. "The submitted data covers the details about all the electrical variables in a railway traction power system under the four types of railway smart grid schemes, which integrate new energies such as photovoltaics into the traction power system via DC microgrids.". Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
